scenes.caption: Every data centre runs thousands of servers, day and night. Almost all that power turns into heat.
To keep them from overheating, many data centres cool down with water.
A 2025 study found up to 50 Indian data centres in regions of extremely high water stress.
Chennai. Mumbai. Bengaluru. Cities where every drop already counts.
Here's the good news: smarter cooling is already here.
Treated wastewater, instead of fresh drinking water.
Air-cooled and closed-loop systems that need far less water.
India's energy efficiency guidelines already recommend treated water for cooling.
Cool smarter, and India's digital growth doesn't have to cost its water.

sources: Planet Tracker (2025), as reported by Climate Fact Checks: up to 50 Indian data centres in extremely high water-stress regions
Bureau of Energy Efficiency (2023) cooling guidelines: treated water recommended for cooling-tower make-up
